sections.text: Introduction

This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I3 of emergency diesel engine, which must be performed every 1500 operation hour base as indicated by H 1500 in the title 
block.

The first draft initiated by eng.: Hesham Mohamed Hassan, tested at 17 May 2003, revised by eng.: 
Samir Abdel-Gelil at EDEPCo., 
accepted by maintenance general director: Ali Mostafa Al-lithy and approved by 
eng.: Mostafa Alam Head Sector of Talkha steam power station 2 x 210 
MW.
Safety Precautions

Work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety 
category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.

sections.text: Work to be carried out

Before isolated the diesel engine mechanically 
 and electrically.

The engine must be operated 
 and check the following steps and reads all the available record values and 
 putted in operation & maintenance record data sheet (MRDS) Table (1).

rows: Check the oil level in the tank.
Check the fuel level in the fuel tank

Check the 
 compression pressures in the individual cylinders

Check the 
 uniform power distribution on cylinders

Check any 
 leakage from the piping connections to the diesel engine or its accessories 
 (water, lube oil, fuel, and air).

Check (by 
 listening) the regular operation of the engine and whether there is no 
 abnormal sounds or knocks

Check whether 
 there are no heavy knocks in the injection valve pipe.

Check the 
 operation of suction and exhaust valves, check the condition of the valve 
 springs

Check (by touch) 
 the crankshaft and camshaft bearings temperature rise on the case covers of 
 the cylinder blocks, at the points where the bearings are located

Check the 
 starting valves for tightness by touching the starting air pipes heating on 
 cylinder heads

sections.text: Notes:

After isolated the diesel engine 
mechanically and electrically

Check whether the suction and 
 exhaust valve clearance are correct by means of gauges as follow.

items:
Check the oil level in the tank and / 
 or refill it from the storage tank up to the top mark on the level gauge.

Turn the handles of 
 the coarse (lamination type) oil cleaner fitted in the oil circuit.

Check the 
 clogging of the fine oil cleaners acc.to the differential pressure gauges 
 data.

Check the 
 amount of leakage from stuffing box of fuel pump and prevented it by retighten 
 the gland bolts or replace the sealing ring 
 { it must be dropped some drops to cool the 
 gland}.

Check the 
 temperature of the crankshaft bearings by touching the side lids of the upper 
 engine case, thus the safety of operation is increased. 
 * At higher temperature it is 
 necessary to dismantle the lids and to check the condition of bearing cca 10 
 min after engine stopping.

Check the 
 suction pipe for tightness. Imperfect tightness will manifest itself in the 
 output of the engine And remove any leakage if found.

Remove the cylinder heads and check 
 the suction and exhaust valves for tightness.
 * Remove the carbon deposits from the 
 exhaust valve seats.
 *
 Re-machine the valve on the milling machine and grind them.

Check the tightness of the cylinder 
 heads incase of untightness tighten the bolts of cylinder heads.
De-water the air vessel with head.

Check the 
 lubrication of rocker arms and valve guides and adjusted the regulation valves 
 of lubrication if needed

Check whether the suction and 
 exhaust valve clearance are correct by means of gauges as follow.

sections.text:
At a cold 
 engine

Check the clearance between the 
 valve and the rocker arms roller with the 
 responding cam in its basic position.
Adjust the clearance if necessary.

items:
Check the clearance between the 
 valve and the rocker arms roller with the 
 responding cam in its basic position.
Adjust the clearance if necessary.

sections.text:
Check the fuel injection pump, check 
 particularly the pump plunger wear.

* Uncouple the fuel injection pump from the fuel injection valves and close it 
 tightly (Is 
 recommended to use a plug screw for this propose).

*
 Take out the pump by hand by 
 means of the lever supplied with the engine tools.

* Fit the lever into the hole in the tappet guide body above the fuel 
 injection pump 
 tappet.

* If there is a hard 
 resistance, it is a sign that the piston clearance is correct.

items:
Clean the crankcase and the oil 
 tank.

Change the lubricating oil if 
 necessary (See major maintenance procedure).

* If there is a soft resistance, (with the lever slowly dropping), it is a 
 sign that the piston clearance is large and piston must be replaced.

Check the nuts tightening of 
 injection cams (See major maintenance procedure)

Clean and flush with fuel the 
 suction strainer in the oil tank.

Let the sludge and water out of the 
 fuel tank.

Clean the fine double fuel cleaner, 
 located on the upper part of the crankcase, at the front of the engine.
 * Wash the 
 cleaning insert in the fuel oil and flush out cleaner casing.
 * For 
 servicing during operation, any of the two units can be putout of service by turning a control pin.

Clean the fine oil cleaner acc. to 
 the instruction supplied with the cleaner.

Drain the sludge from the coarse 
 (lamination typed) oil cleaner and / or remove the inserts 
 * Clean the body of cleaner. 
 * Wash the 
 inserts in fuel oil.

Check the flow of water through the 
 engine, be sure that there is no clogging by impurities, throttling or 
 clogging with scales on the water transfer pipe and remove the scales if found 
 (See major maintenance procedure).

Clean 
 the air cleaner of the turbo-blower.
 * Wash it in 
 fuel oil.

Clean the air distributor and smear 
 it with grease.

Check the fuel injection valves or 
 removal of the valves from the cylinder head (by means of a nozzle tester) 
 * Check the 
 setting of the opening pressure.
 * Check the 
 fuel is sprayed by the valve through all holes and clean these holes if it is clogged by means of the nozzle cleaner.

Check the function and the 
 reliability of the signaling equipment. When checking and adjust the signaling 
 equipment, it is absolutely necessary to check continuously the operating 
 conditions of the engine specially the oil pressure.

Keep the surface of the engine 
 clean.
